requires.for: consistent accepted-state reads, immutable history and short transactional writes
Customer Organization and reusable reference identities
Service Request identity, lifecycle and Customer context
accepted Report Date/status/suspension observations and classification proposals

constrained_by.for: canonical UTC arithmetic, fixed America/Guayaquil SLA calendar authority and immutable audit/history semantics

consumed_by.for: Overview metrics, warnings and report projections

forbidden_dependencies: SLA must not use Objective scheduling timezone for cohort month or elapsed-duration authority.
SLA must not read discarded Advanced Search Product as Product Line classification authority.
SLA must not infer suspension from inactivity or local timers.
Completed reports must not depend on mutable live projections for historical truth.
Cohort membership must not depend on the derived compliance outcome/state.

lld_handoffs.scope: Product Line/Contract/CPL schema, policy revisions, classification, SLA arithmetic, cohort algorithms and report evidence
